scope_note: Tier 1-2 findings are mandala-rails repo-scoped; Tier 3 findings (firewall, OS update) are machine-level per the skill's CSO framing.

findings.title: ruby/setup-ruby@v1 not SHA-pinned (third-party action)
findings.detail: Third-party action pinned to mutable tag v1, not a commit SHA. Tag repoint (maintainer compromise or force-move) executes attacker code in CI with GITHUB_TOKEN and source checkout in scope. tj-actions/changed-files attack class.
findings.fix: uses: ruby/setup-ruby@<40-char-sha>  # v1.x.x ; add .github/dependabot.yml for github-actions ecosystem.

findings.title: Application firewall disabled (State = 0)
findings.detail: macOS application firewall off. Local listening services (Postgres 17, com.mandala.litestream, bin/mcp, Rails dev server) are unfiltered on inbound connections; exposure risk on untrusted networks. FileVault and SIP both on.
findings.fix: System Settings -> Network -> Firewall -> On. User action (security setting).

findings.title: Pending macOS security update (Tahoe 26.5.2, recommended)
findings.detail: softwareupdate -l reports macOS Tahoe 26.5.2 (Recommended: YES, requires restart) uninstalled. Recommended point releases are typically security-relevant.
findings.fix: Install when a restart is acceptable.

findings.title: First-party actions tag-pinned, not SHA-pinned
findings.detail: actions/checkout@v7 and actions/cache@v6 pinned to mutable tags. GitHub-maintained so lower risk than Finding 1, but still tag-mutable. Skill rule: first-party actions unpinned = MEDIUM.
findings.fix: SHA-pin with version comment. Lower priority than Finding 1.

findings.title: No CODEOWNERS on workflow files
findings.detail: No CODEOWNERS file in repo. Any write-access collaborator can modify ci.yml (e.g. add secret-exfil step) without mandatory second review. Low urgency on single-maintainer private repo.

tier1: config/credentials.yml.enc encrypted (world-readable is Rails design, not a finding)
tier2: Git history clean of literal secret values (AKIA/sk-ant/ghp_/gho_/pat/xox)
Api::V1::BaseController skip_forgery_protection correct (Bearer-token auth, no session-cookie surface, rate-limited)
tier3: gh token scopes (gist, read:org, repo, workflow) normal for dev use
No unfamiliar GitHub OAuth app installations

trend.note: First report — baseline established. No prior report to compare.
